cases.title: Use Cases

items.title: Real-Time AI Assistant for Patients
items.challenge: Patients struggled to access clear information about their treatments between appointments, leading to uncertainty and low adherence.
items.solution: An AI conversational agent integrated with the clinical system, allowing patients to query their treatments, medications, appointments, and recommendations at any time.
items.result: Higher treatment adherence, fewer unnecessary medical queries, and a significantly better patient experience.

items.title: Mathematical Models for Rights Distribution and Collection
items.challenge: A rights management company needed to optimize royalty distribution and improve collection forecasting across complex networks of authors and platforms.
items.solution: Mathematical models analyzing consumption patterns and historical data to project revenue, optimize distribution by channel, and detect anomalies — integrated into existing systems.
items.result: Greater accuracy in rights settlement, fewer disputes between parties, and stronger financial forecasting.

items.title: Data Lake and Data Governance
items.challenge: The company operated with data scattered across multiple systems — CRM, ERP, sales portals, and financial platforms — with no centralized architecture.
items.solution: A centralized Data Lake with governance policies, a data catalog, and quality rules integrating all sources into a unified analytics layer.
items.result: A unified business view, faster and more agile reporting, and advanced analytics capabilities across portfolio, pricing, and client data.
